Container.Name: Courarr
Container.Overview: Courarr builds filtered anime lists from AniList (this season, next season, a year, genres, tags, popularity…) and serves each one as a Custom List URL for Sonarr (TVDB IDs) or Radarr (TMDB IDs). Lists refresh every day at 3 AM or on demand from the web UI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web UI and the list feed URLs Sonarr/Radarr poll.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database (lists, settings) and the cached anime ID mapping.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.
